name: ToggleGroup
description: Picks exactly one option from a short row of toggle buttons.
propsSummary: gap: sm|none|xs (default: xs for ghost; none otherwise)

onChange.description: Called with new value when selection changes

onValueChange.description: Alias for onChange (Radix convention): (value: string) => void

variant.description: Chrome: soft is the filled rail, ghost the open pill cluster, outline the connected bordered segments

gap.description: Gap between items in the ghost variant. Connected variants intentionally ignore gaps.

when: Switching between mutually exclusive views or modes
Choosing one of two to five options
whenNot: More than one can be picked — use a Checkbox group
More than five options — use Select or RadioGroup
guidelines: Labels short enough to scan in one pass
Icons work for well-known modes like grid and list
soft for an inset tonal rail, ghost for an open filter cluster, outline for connected segments
Keep targets at least 24px on touch
accessibility: The group is a radiogroup; each item is a radio with aria-checked
Arrow keys move between items, Tab enters and leaves the group
Icon-only items still need an aria-label
Focus stays visible on the selected item

examples.name: Default
examples.description: Inset tonal rail; the selected segment lifts.

examples.name: Ghost
examples.description: Detached rounded buttons for open filter clusters.

examples.name: Outline
examples.description: Bordered segments sharing one continuous edge.
examples.code:
<ToggleGroup value={value} onChange={setValue} variant="outline">
  <ToggleGroup.Item value="day">Day</ToggleGroup.Item>
  <ToggleGroup.Item value="week">Week</ToggleGroup.Item>
  <ToggleGroup.Item value="month">Month</ToggleGroup.Item>
</ToggleGroup>

examples.name: Uncontrolled
examples.description: defaultValue when nothing outside needs the selection.

examples.name: Sizes
examples.description: sm for toolbars, lg where the rail anchors a page.
examples.code:
import { Stack } from '@/components/Stack';

<Stack direction="column" gap="md" align="start">
  <ToggleGroup defaultValue="a" size="sm">
    <ToggleGroup.Item value="a">Small</ToggleGroup.Item>
    <ToggleGroup.Item value="b">Rail</ToggleGroup.Item>
  </ToggleGroup>
  <ToggleGroup defaultValue="a" size="md">
    <ToggleGroup.Item value="a">Medium</ToggleGroup.Item>
    <ToggleGroup.Item value="b">Rail</ToggleGroup.Item>
  </ToggleGroup>
  <ToggleGroup defaultValue="a" size="lg">
    <ToggleGroup.Item value="a">Large</ToggleGroup.Item>
    <ToggleGroup.Item value="b">Rail</ToggleGroup.Item>
  </ToggleGroup>
</Stack>

examples.name: View Switcher
examples.description: Icon-only modes, each named for screen readers.
examples.code:
import { SquaresFour as GridIcon, ListBullets as ListIcon } from '@phosphor-icons/react';

<ToggleGroup value={view} onChange={setView} size="sm">
  <ToggleGroup.Item value="grid" aria-label="Grid view">
    <GridIcon aria-hidden />
  </ToggleGroup.Item>
  <ToggleGroup.Item value="list" aria-label="List view">
    <ListIcon aria-hidden />
  </ToggleGroup.Item>
</ToggleGroup>

examples.name: Disabled Item
examples.description: One option locked out; the rest stay reachable.
examples.code:
<ToggleGroup value={value} onChange={setValue}>
  <ToggleGroup.Item value="basic">Basic</ToggleGroup.Item>
  <ToggleGroup.Item value="pro">Pro</ToggleGroup.Item>
  <ToggleGroup.Item value="enterprise" disabled>Enterprise</ToggleGroup.Item>
</ToggleGroup>

propsSummary: onChange: (value: string) => void - change handler (or onValueChange)
variant: soft|ghost|outline - chrome (soft rail, ghost cluster, outline segments)
gap: none|xs|sm - ghost spacing (xs by default; connected variants remain gapless)
